maavadao_api_url.description: Base URL of the maavaDao Configuration API (e.g. https://api.maavadao.ai/api/v1)

maavadao_api_token.description: Bearer token for authenticating with the maavaDao API

gemini_api_key.description: Google Gemini API Key — auto-injected into GEMINI_API_KEY env var for nano-banana-pro skill. Optional if env var is already set.

sponge_api_key.description: PaySponge API Key — used for wallet operations, payment links, and USDC transactions. Optional if SPONGE_API_KEY env var is already set.
